head_commit.message:
chore(tui2): satisfy viewport clippy lints

Tidy up the transcript viewport helpers in codex-tui2 so they compile cleanly under the stricter clippy config used by this workspace.

This folds nested if-let patterns when resolving scroll anchors, switches manual repeat/take loops to repeat_n, replaces fallible conversions with infallible ones, and uses iterator helpers instead of index-only loops when walking transcript metadata. The changes are purely mechanical and keep the existing transcript scroll and selection behavior intact, as verified by the codex-tui2 test suite and cargo check.

workflow_runs.display_title: WIP: Rework TUI viewport, history printing, and selection/copy

head_commit.message:
fix(tui2): refine viewport spacing and drag scroll lock

Tighten the initial inline layout so the chat composer sits immediately beneath the last rendered transcript line when history is short, eliminating the extra blank spacer row that caused the first user prompt and its history cell to jump upward as soon as the transcript started to grow.

At the same time, refine the streaming scroll behavior so auto-follow is only disabled when the user performs an actual drag selection: a simple click in the transcript continues to leave  in place, while a drag that extends the selection anchors scroll state away from the bottom before ongoing streaming output arrives. The mouse handler documentation is updated to describe this drag-based scroll lock, and the codex-tui2 tests and helpers are adjusted to use  consistently. All codex-tui2 tests and checks pass after the change.
